name: Production Agent Hung Daemon
description: Detects when production agent daemon is hung (heartbeat age > 5 minutes)

query.query: SELECT * FROM signoz_logs.logs_v2 WHERE attributes['type'] = 'heartbeat_alert' AND attributes['system'] = 'production-agent-system' AND attributes['details.ageSeconds'] > 300 AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTES

annotations.description: The production agent daemon has not sent a heartbeat for more than 5 minutes, indicating it may be hung
